description: Log a tool call within a trace. Records tool name, arguments, result, duration, and token usage. Auto-calculates cost estimate.

duration_ms.description: How long the tool call took in milliseconds

result_preview.description: Brief preview of the result (max 500 chars)

span_id.description: Span this tool call belongs to (optional)

tokens_used.description: Token count for this call (optional, enables cost estimation)

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that was called

trace_id.description: Trace this tool call belongs to

name: trace_tool_call
